title: Modern Sushi-Making Class in Calgary (Includes 4-Course Meal)
blurb:
Discover the bold flavors of modern Japanese cuisine in this immersive sushi-making class in Calgary, hosted through Cozymeal. This 4-course experience combines traditional methods with creative twists, offering an engaging, hands-on culinary adventure.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- First course: Spicy California roll with crab, avocado, cucumber, jalapeño, sesame, spicy mayo
- Second course: Philadelphia roll with smoked salmon, cream cheese, shrimp tempura, avocado, mango mayo
- Third course: Double crab roll with fresh & grilled crab, avocado, cucumber, sesame, unagi & spicy mayo
- Dessert: Warm Korean pancake with ice cream & syrup

This interactive class highlights the creativity of sushi-making while building your confidence in the kitchen. Set in a relaxed small-group setting, it’s ideal for couples, friends or anyone eager to explore modern Japanese flavors. Guests may bring their favorite wine or beer to pair with the meal.
